summary.problem: isTrustedSystemPath rejects binaries in /nix/store on Nix systems, causing Ripgrep validation to fail and fall back to GrepTool.
summary.root_cause: The unix trustedPrefixes array in isTrustedSystemPath() inside packages/core/src/utils/paths.ts does not include /nix/store.
summary.context: Nix installs packages in /nix/store. When system ripgrep resolves to a /nix/store path, isTrustedSystemPath returns false, causing gemini-cli to fall back to GrepTool which can hang indefinitely on large codebases.

steps: In packages/core/src/utils/paths.ts, locate the isTrustedSystemPath function.
Add '/nix/store' to the trustedPrefixes array within the Unix/macOS/Linux branch.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: isTrustedSystemPath should return true for binary paths under /nix/store on Unix platforms.
verification_steps: In packages/core/src/utils/paths.test.ts, add an assertion in the isTrustedSystemPath test suite checking that expect(isTrustedSystemPath('/nix/store/abc123-ripgrep-13.0.0/bin/rg')).toBe(true).
Run Vitest on packages/core/src/utils/paths.test.ts to confirm all tests pass.

github_metadata.title: isTrustedSystemPath rejects binaries in /nix/store, causing catastrophic fallback to GrepTool
